mapper.sql: id, member_id, requested_intensity, requested_bpm_min, requested_bpm_max, requested_genre, request_conditions, result_summary, recommendation_reason, saved_playlist_id, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_logs ( member_id, requested_intensity, requested_bpm_min, requested_bpm_max, requested_genre, request_conditions, result_summary, recommendation_reason ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{requestedIntensity}, #{requestedBpmMin}, #{requestedBpmMax}, #{requestedGenre}, #{requestConditions}, #{resultSummary}, #{recommendationReason} )
